**Finding: NONCOMPETE — compliant (preferred position met).**

No restraint on Bluefly's business exists anywhere in the Agreement:

- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** — "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." expressly preserves our freedom to contract with IBM's competitors.
- **§ 14.11 No Resale** — bars only resale of IBM's own Services; this is a licence-scope limit, not a non-compete or field-of-use restriction on what we may operate, buy or build.
- **§ 12.1 / § 14.17** — ordinary nonexclusive licence scope and no-implied-licence wording.
- **§ 14.19 Geographic Scope** — limits IBM's delivery obligations only, not our activities.

Targeted searches for "compet*", "exclusive", "Customer shall not/may not", field-of-use, territory and sole-source/requirements language surfaced nothing binding us. No redline proposed.
